data.name: Theodore
data.gender_notes: Theodore is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek theos, 'God', + dōron, 'gift' — 'gift of God'. Its root is Greek theos + dōron. Saint Theodore the Recruit; several saints. Theodore is a Greek name meaning “Gift of God”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Theodore expresses “Gift of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Greek theos, 'God', + dōron, 'gift' — 'gift of God'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Theodore total 45, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
